name: ECM USA
old_description: Lab, university, and research & development heat treat solutions for semiconductor wafer processing
about:
ECM USA operates from Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, positioned between Milwaukee and Chicago. The company serves as the American subsidiary of the France-based ECM Group, which consolidates thermal, gas, and atmosphere management expertise across multiple brands headquartered near Grenoble and Montpellier. ECM USA established its Synergy Center in Pleasant Prairie in 2018, housing a NANO vacuum furnace for on-site process development and metallurgical testing.

The company designs and manufactures vacuum furnace systems using cold-wall, electric heating technology that eliminates open flames and enables higher temperature treatments with easy integration into machining lines. Its furnace portfolio includes the ECO double-chamber, JUMBO high-volume, FLEX modular, NANO small-batch, VESUVE nitriding/FNC, FULGURA multi-flow, TURQUOISE horizontal, LILLIPUT hearth-lift, CRISTAL bell, and PFTH vertical oil-quench models, with maximum work zones up to 1,500 mm and load capacities to 2,000 kg. Core processes cover low-pressure vacuum carburizing (LPC), carbonitriding, brazing, sintering, vacuum induction melting, vacuum arc remelting, tempering, vacuum purged gas nitriding, ferritic nitrocarburizing, and vapor-phase aluminizing. Through the ECM Greentech division, it supplies semiconductor wafer-processing furnaces for diffusion, oxidation, doping, and rapid thermal processing up to 300 mm wafers, plus silicon ingot casting and crystal growth equipment. ECM Robotics provides automation integration ranging from cleanroom wafer handling to heavy automotive loads exceeding 1,000 kg.

ECM USA serves the automotive, aerospace, marine, agricultural, semiconductor, solar/photovoltaic, and general industrial heat-treat sectors, as well as university and R&D laboratories. Customers in the United States, Canada, and Mexico include EV transmission manufacturers using LPC, semiconductor fabs requiring wafer processing and SiC crystal growth, and solar producers casting PV silicon ingots. The Synergy Center allows prospective buyers to run low-pressure carburizing and high-pressure gas quenching trials with on-site CMM dimensional measurement, 3D microscopy, and hardness testing before committing to a system purchase.

The company emphasizes that its cold-wall vacuum technology prevents inter-granular oxidation during carburizing, minimizes energy consumption and CO2 emissions, and improves metallurgical properties and process repeatability. Field service, installation, training, and aftermarket parts availability are positioned as integral to the offering, supported by the ECM Group's 50-plus years of engineering and design experience.
